playwright.about: Headless browser: open the app, click through it, take screenshots to check UI/layout.

context7.about: Up-to-date library/framework documentation on demand (stops hallucinated APIs).

serena.about: Symbol-level code navigation via language servers (find symbol, references, implementations, file overview) — read only; its editing tools are denied in settings.json so edits keep going through claude-smart hooks.
serena.needs: uv (uvx); language servers: Go needs gopls, others are downloaded on first use
next: Index once, in the project dir (otherwise the first search takes minutes): uvx --from git+https://github.com/oraios/serena serena project index
Several languages (e.g. Go backend + TS frontend)? list them under language_servers in .serena/project.yml, then index again
Commit .serena/project.yml (Serena ignores .serena/cache itself). Restart Claude and approve the server in /mcp

github.about: Issues, PRs, reviews, releases from inside Claude Code.

postgres.about: Inspect schema and query a LOCAL/DEV PostgreSQL in restricted (read-only) mode.

mongodb.about: Inspect collections and query a LOCAL/DEV MongoDB, read-only.

claude-context.about: Vector (embedding) semantic search over the whole codebase. For very large repos. Needs an embedding API key and a Milvus/Zilliz instance — check the package README for current env names.
